en-US.description: Local-first AI image generation, dictionary, and asset management desktop app.
en-US.longDescription: AIY Image Tools is a local-first AI image generation, dictionary, and asset management desktop app. At runtime it uses SQLite and a managed media directory as its primary stores, and does not read business data from React components or web demos. It offers two independent image generation options — a Codex App Server and the Codex CLI — with stable model keys that keep existing drafts and tasks compatible; image generation, the Codex assistant, sessions, and title suggestions run in separate per-library background model processes.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 生图、词典与素材管理桌面工具。
zh-CN.longDescription: AIY 生图管理工具是本地优先的 AI 生图、词典与素材管理桌面工具。正式运行时以 SQLite 与受管媒体目录为主库，不从 React 组件或网页 Demo 读取业务数据。应用提供彼此独立的 Codex App Server 与 Codex CLI 两个生图选项，模型键保持稳定以兼容已有草稿和任务；图片生成、Codex 助手、会话和标题建议由“每个资料库一个”的独立后台模型进程执行。
zh-CN.name: AIY Image Tools
